paper_title: Limits on Axion Couplings from the first 80-day data of PandaX-II Experiment
notes: Paper constrains axion-electron coupling g_Ae. Solar CBRD axion limit ~4e-13 for mA 1e-5 to 1 keV (abstract states 4.35e-12 but text body states 4e-13; values inconsistent in paper). Galactic ALP limit ~4.3e-13 for 1-25 keV (best 4.3e-14 quoted in summary). 57Fe limit best 6e-14 at 10 keV. Data points are approximate readings from text since plots (Fig 3, 4) not numerically tabulated.
